platformFee.q: How does the platform fee work?
platformFee.a: A flat fee is deducted from each lesson payment based on your subscription tier. Starter pays €1.00 per booking, Professional pays €0.75, and Academy pays €0.50.

changePlans.a: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you get immediate access to new features. When downgrading, changes take effect at the end of your billing cycle.

contract.q: Is there a contract or commitment?
contract.a: No long-term contracts. All plans are billed monthly or yearly, and you can cancel anytime. Yearly plans offer 20% savings.

payouts.a: Payments are processed through Mollie, our trusted payment partner. After a lesson is completed, funds are transferred to your connected bank account, typically within 2-3 business days.

clubTrial.q: How does the club free trial work?
clubTrial.a: Clubs get a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start. After the trial, you'll be billed annually at €2,388/year.

hero.title: Making padel training
hero.subtitle: We're on a mission to connect every padel player in the Netherlands with the perfect trainer to help them improve their game.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: PadelTrainer.ai was born from a simple frustration: finding a good padel trainer shouldn't be this hard. As padel exploded in popularity across the Netherlands, we saw players struggling to find quality training, while talented trainers had no easy way to reach new students.
story.p2: We set out to build the platform we wished existed. One where players could easily find verified trainers matched to their skill level, and where trainers could grow their business without the hassle of managing bookings, payments, and scheduling.
story.p3: Today, PadelTrainer.ai connects hundreds of trainers with thousands of players across the Netherlands. We're proud to be part of the growing padel community and excited about where we're heading next.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to PadelTrainer.ai ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

dataCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

items.account: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, and profile photo when you create an account.
items.profile: Profile Data: For trainers, this includes certifications, experience, specializations, KNLTB ratings, and availability schedules.
items.booking: Booking Information: Lesson details, booking history, and communication between players and trainers.
items.payment: Payment Information: We use Mollie for payment processing. We do not store your full credit card details on our servers.
items.communications: Communications: When you contact us or respond to surveys, we collect the information you provide.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use the collected information for:

items.provide: Providing, maintaining, and improving our platform
items.send: Sending booking confirmations, reminders, and updates
items.facilitate: Facilitating communication between players and trainers
items.analyze: Analyzing usage patterns to improve user experience
items.prevent: Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.intro: We may share your information in the following situations:

items.users: With Trainers/Players: To facilitate bookings, we share relevant contact and booking information between parties.
items.providers: Service Providers: We use third-party services for payment processing (Mollie), email delivery (Resend), and hosting infrastructure.
items.legal: Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property.
items.business: Business Transfers: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to:

items.login: Keep you logged in to your account
items.analyze: Analyze how you use our platform

cookies.control: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling them may affect platform functionality.

security.title: 6. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data but cannot guarantee absolute security.

gdpr.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
gdpr.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

items.access: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
items.rectification: Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
items.erasure: Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
items.restriction: Restriction: Request limitation of data processing
items.portability: Portability: Request transfer of your data to another service
items.objection: Objection: Object to processing of your data
items.withdraw: Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent

gdpr.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at privacy@padeltrainer.ai.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. We may retain certain information for legitimate business purposes or as required by law, such as for tax, legal reporting, and auditing obligations.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our platform is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete that information.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

agreement.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
agreement.content: By accessing or using PadelTrainer.ai ("Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access the Platform. These Terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use the Platform.

description.title: 2. Description of Service
description.content: PadelTrainer.ai is an online platform that connects padel players ("Players") with padel trainers ("Trainers"). We provide scheduling, booking, and payment processing tools to facilitate training sessions. PadelTrainer.ai acts as an intermediary and is not a party to the agreements between Players and Trainers.

accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
accounts.intro: When you create an account with us, you must provide accurate, complete, and current information. You are responsible for:

items.confidentiality: Maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password
items.activities: All activities that occur under your account
items.notify: Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account

players.title: 4. For Players
players.intro: As a Player using our Platform, you agree to:

items.accurate: Provide accurate information when booking lessons
items.pay: Pay for booked lessons as agreed
items.arrive: Arrive on time for scheduled sessions
items.respect: Treat Trainers with respect and professionalism
items.cancellation: Follow the cancellation policy outlined below
items.reviews: Leave honest and fair reviews based on your actual experience

trainers.title: 5. For Trainers
trainers.intro: As a Trainer using our Platform, you agree to:

items.qualifications: Provide accurate information about your qualifications and experience
items.quality: Provide professional, safe, and quality training sessions
items.respond: Respond to booking requests in a timely manner
items.comply: Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
items.fees: Pay platform fees as specified in your subscription plan

forPlayers.title: For Players:
forPlayers.content: Payment is processed through Mollie at the time of booking. The full lesson price is charged to your payment method. Refunds are handled according to our cancellation policy.

forTrainers.title: For Trainers:
forTrainers.content: PadelTrainer.ai charges a flat platform fee per completed booking, which varies by subscription plan (e.g., €1.00 for Starter, €0.75 for Professional, €0.50 for Academy). The remaining amount is transferred to your connected Mollie account. Subscription fees are billed according to your chosen plan.

cancellation.title: 7. Cancellation Policy

items.24h: More than 24 hours before: Full refund
items.less12h: Less than 12 hours before: No refund
items.trainer: Trainer cancellations: Players receive a full refund for any trainer-initiated cancellation

cancellation.note: Repeated cancellations by either party may result in account restrictions or termination.

ip.title: 8. Intellectual Property
ip.content: The Platform and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by PadelTrainer.ai and are protected by international copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and other intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, create derivative works of, publicly display, or exploit any content from our Platform without prior written permission.

userContent.content: You retain ownership of any content you submit to the Platform (reviews, profile information, etc.). By submitting content, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, and display such content in connection with operating the Platform. You are solely responsible for the content you submit and must ensure it does not violate any third-party rights or applicable laws.

items.circumvent: Attempt to circumvent the Platform to avoid fees
items.scrape: Scrape or collect user data without consent

disclaimer.title: 11. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.content: The Platform is provided on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis. We make no warranties, expressed or implied, regarding the Platform's operation or the information, content, or materials included. We do not guarantee the accuracy, reliability, or completeness of any information on the Platform. liability.title: 12. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, PadelTrainer.ai shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or other intangible losses, resulting from your use or inability to use the Platform, any conduct of third parties on the Platform, or unauthorized access to your account.

indemnification.title: 13. Indemnification
indemnification.content: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless PadelTrainer.ai, its officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, and expenses (including legal fees) arising from your use of the Platform, violation of these Terms, or infringement of any third-party rights.

items.platform: With PadelTrainer.ai: Any disputes with the Platform shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with Dutch law, or through the courts of the Netherlands.

termination.title: 15. Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice, for any reason, including breach of these Terms. Upon termination, your right to use the Platform will immediately cease. All provisions of the Terms which should survive termination shall survive, including ownership provisions, warranty disclaimers, and limitations of liability.

What constitutes a material change will be determined at our sole discretion. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
